rules.name: recon-stuck-01-refresh-runs
rules.sql: SELECT localtimestamp AS db_now, current_setting('TimeZone') AS db_time_zone, max(requested_at) AS last_requested, max(started_at) AS last_started, max(completed_at) AS last_completed, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (started_at - requested_at))))::numeric, 0) AS median_request_to_start_seconds, count(*) AS runs FROM opera.recon_refresh_run WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND requested_at >= :since AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'MANUAL_TEST'

SELECT view_type, status, count(*) AS runs, min(requested_at) AS first_requested, max(requested_at) AS last_requested FROM opera.recon_refresh_run WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND requested_at >= :since AND status <> 'MANUAL_TEST' GROUP BY view_type, status ORDER BY view_type, status

SELECT r.business_unit, r.view_type, r.resolved_settlement_date, r.status, r.requested_by, r.requested_at, r.started_at, round(extract(epoch FROM (localtimestamp - coalesce(r.started_at, r.requested_at))) / 60) AS age_minutes, n.status AS next_run_status, n.requested_at AS next_requested_at FROM opera.recon_refresh_run r LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.status, x.requested_at FROM opera.recon_refresh_run x WHERE x.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND x.business_unit = r.business_unit AND x.view_type = r.view_type AND x.resolved_settlement_date = r.resolved_settlement_date AND x.requested_at > r.requested_at AND x.status <> 'MANUAL_TEST' ORDER BY x.requested_at LIMIT 1 ) n ON true WHERE r.tenant_id = :tenant AND r.requested_at >= :since AND ((r.status = 'REQUESTED' AND r.requested_at < localtimestamp - make_interval(mins => :stuckMinutes)) OR (r.status = 'RUNNING' AND r.started_at < localtimestamp - make_interval(mins => :stuckMinutes))) ORDER BY r.requested_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT view_type, left(error_message, 100) AS error_start, count(*) AS runs, min(requested_at) AS first_seen, max(requested_at) AS last_seen FROM opera.recon_refresh_run WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND requested_at >= :since AND status = 'FAILED' GROUP BY view_type, left(error_message, 100) ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT business_unit, view_type, count(*) AS runs, max(row_count) AS max_rows, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (completed_at - started_at))))::numeric, 0) AS median_seconds, round((percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (completed_at - started_at))))::numeric, 0) AS p90_seconds, round(max(extract(epoch FROM (completed_at - started_at)))::numeric, 0) AS max_seconds FROM opera.recon_refresh_run WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND requested_at >= :since AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY business_unit, view_type ORDER BY max(extract(epoch FROM (completed_at - started_at))) DESC LIMIT 40

SELECT p.business_unit, p.view_type, p.settlement_date, p.published_at, l.status AS newest_run_status, l.requested_at AS newest_requested_at, left(l.error_message, 120) AS newest_error FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.uuid, r.status, r.requested_at, r.error_message FROM opera.recon_refresh_run r WHERE r.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND r.business_unit = p.business_unit AND r.view_type = p.view_type AND r.resolved_settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND r.status <> 'MANUAL_TEST' ORDER BY r.requested_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) l ON true WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.settlement_date >= :since AND l.uuid <> p.published_run_id ORDER BY l.requested_at DESC LIMIT 100

expect.reason: no run is stuck in REQUESTED or RUNNING longer than stuckMinutes (same defect as Combined VAR stuck in Processing)
no published report is waiting behind a refresh that has not finished
